collateral.hyperliquid_portfolio_margin_collateral: BTC and HYPE only (docs read 2026-10-10, term_carry); no gold token

PAXG.fees: creation waived through 2027-01-01 (then 0.02 PAXG under 2 oz, 1.0% → 0.125% by size); redemption 0.125% on the first $2M of 30-day net redemptions, 0.25% to $10M, 0.35% to $20M, 0.5% above (from 2026-09-01); in-kind conversion to bars 0.05%; no storage fee
PAXG.issuer: Paxos Trust Company (NYDFS-regulated); 1 PAXG = 1 fine troy oz in London Good Delivery bars
PAXG.redeem: Paxos account holders (onboarded, KYC) can sell PAXG to Paxos for USD at the gold price or take allocated bars/unallocated gold; physical bars need about 430 oz plus fees (third-party guides; the official minimums article was not read)

XAUT.fees: 0.25% on creation and redemption plus a 150 USDT verification fee (third-party listings: rwa.xyz, MEXC; Tether's own terms page is script-rendered and was not read)
XAUT.issuer: TG Commodities Limited (Tether Gold); 1 XAUT = 1 troy oz in a Swiss vault
XAUT.redeem: verified TG Commodities customers (non-US); physical delivery to a Swiss address, minimum about 430 XAUT per third-party listings; USD redemption possible

_implied_carry.method: (a) -step of the daily median PAXG/GC=F at each GC=F roll x 12 / months between contracts; (b) ln(GC=F / Binance spot index) / years to last trading day, US-session hours. Both include COMEX's premium over London (EFP), which blew out in 2024-12..2025-02
